title: Salmon Wrap with Charred Veggies
description: A flavorful and healthy Canadian-inspired dish featuring grilled salmon and charred vegetables wrapped in a hearty wrap.
instructions: Season salmon with salt and pepper.
Grill the salmon for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, brush the bell peppers, onions, and zucchini with oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the vegetables for 3-4 minutes per side, or until charred.
Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the grilled salmon and vegetables inside.
Drizzle with your favorite sauce, if desired.
